serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
We got into our plane with no issues.
TSA doesn’t pay much attention to the people who are leaving and there should be no problem when we land.
The city looks entirely different from above.
It looks so peaceful. Silent. Entirely different from how it is in reality.
I met many people there. Good and bad. I got hurt many times, but in the end it was all worth it.
Now I’m leaving it behind with people that I care about. I never imagined that such an ending could be possible.
